name: Operations Agents
description: Operations Agents are a new capability in Real-Time Intelligence designed to act like virtual team members—monitoring data, recognizing patterns, and recommending actions in real time. They combine LLMs with rule-based logic to track operational goals, surface insights, and trigger workflows when conditions are met. The agent builds up an internal playbook to understand the domain, uses rules to define when to act, and logs everything for traceability and feedback. It’s all about helping customers move from insight to action faster, with humans in the loop where needed
